articles.title_en: Emission Caps and Investment in Green Technologies
articles.title_cn: 排放上限与绿色技术投资
articles.abstract_en: We study the interaction between firms, which can invest in green technologies, and a government, which can impose emission caps but has limited commitment power. Investment in green technologies generates innovation spillovers, reducing the cost of further investments. Spillovers generate intertemporal strategic complementarities between firms and government, and equilibrium multiplicity. In a “green equilibrium”, firms, anticipating caps, invest in green technologies, which reduces the cost of further investment, making the government willing to cap emissions. In a “brown equilibrium”, firms, anticipating no caps, don’t invest, so green technologies remain costly and the government gives up on emission caps.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究可以投资绿色技术的企业与政府之间的互动，其中政府能够设定排放上限，但承诺能力有限。绿色技术投资会产生创新溢出效应，降低进一步投资的成本。溢出效应在企业与政府之间形成跨期战略互补，并导致均衡多重性。在“绿色均衡”中，企业预期政府会设定上限，因而投资绿色技术；这又降低进一步投资的成本，使政府愿意设定排放上限。在“棕色均衡”中，企业预期政府不会设定上限，因而不投资，绿色技术仍然昂贵，政府最终放弃排放上限。

articles.abstract_en: We build a novel data set of time-stamped corporate decarbonization commitments—green pledges—for U.S. public firms by classifying news articles with large language models and human validation. Firms announcing green pledges tend to be larger and browner than other firms, both within and across industries. Green pledges significantly raise stock prices, consistent with a reduction in the carbon premium, and predict sizable declines in future carbon emissions and emission intensities. These effects tend to be strongest for firms in brown industries. Green pledges thus appear credible, convey relevant new information to investors, and provide meaningful financial incentives to decarbonize.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过大型语言模型分类新闻文章并辅以人工验证，为美国上市公司构建了一个带时间戳的企业脱碳承诺——绿色承诺——新数据集。宣布绿色承诺的企业，无论在行业内部还是行业之间，往往规模更大、碳排放更高。绿色承诺显著提高股价，与碳溢价下降相一致，并预示着未来碳排放量和排放强度将大幅下降。这些影响在高排放行业企业中往往最强。因此，绿色承诺似乎可信，能够向投资者传递相关新信息，并为企业脱碳提供有意义的金融激励。

articles.abstract_en: A fundamental concern about green investing is that it may crowd out political support for public policies addressing negative externalities. We examine this concern in a preregistered experiment conducted shortly before a real referendum on a climate law in Switzerland. We find that offering an opportunity to invest in a climate-friendly fund does not reduce individual support for climate regulation, measured by political donations and voting intentions. A replication of the experiment in the United Kingdom yields similar results. Our estimates reject a crowding-out effect, suggesting instead a modest crowding-in effect of green investing on political support for green policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色投资的一个根本担忧是，它可能挤出公众支持应对负外部性的公共政策。我们在瑞士一项气候法真实公投前不久开展预注册实验，检验这一担忧。我们发现，提供投资气候友好型基金的机会，并不会降低个人对气候监管的支持；这种支持通过政治捐款和投票意向来衡量。在英国开展的实验复制也得到类似结果。我们的估计拒绝了挤出效应，反而表明绿色投资对绿色政策的政治支持具有温和的挤入效应。

articles.title_en: ESG Shocks in Global Supply Chains
articles.abstract_en: We show that U.S. firms cut imports by 31.8% when their international suppliers experience environmental and social (E&S) incidents. These trade cuts are larger for publicly listed U.S. importers facing high E&S investor pressure and lead to cross-country supplier reallocation, suggesting that E&S preferences in capital markets can be privately costly but have real effects for foreign suppliers. Larger trade cuts around the incident result in better supplier E&S performance in subsequent years and in the eventual resumption of trade. Our results highlight the role of investors in ensuring suppliers’ E&S compliance along global supply chains.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们表明，当国际供应商发生环境和社会（E&S）事件时，美国企业会将进口削减31.8%。面对较高E&S投资者压力的美国上市进口商，其贸易削减幅度更大，并会在国家之间重新配置供应商；这表明，资本市场中的E&S偏好可能给企业带来私人成本，但会对外国供应商产生实际影响。事件发生前后的贸易削减越大，供应商随后几年的E&S表现越好，贸易最终恢复的可能性也越高。我们的结果凸显了投资者在确保全球供应链供应商遵守E&S要求方面的作用。

articles.abstract_en: We examine whether politicians affect local firms’ industrial pollution, and whether such effects are transmitted through plant-level networks to affect pollution in other regions. We first document that close Democrat wins in U.S. congressional races are associated with lower emissions and higher abatement at the plant level, especially when politicians have strong pro-environmental preferences. We also find evidence of reallocation: firms shift emissions away from areas represented by Democrats. However, reallocation is imperfect: firm-level costs are higher and market-to-book ratios lower if firms’ representation is more Democratic. Lower pollution-related illnesses around plants in Democratic districts suggest pass-through effects on local communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察政治人物是否会影响当地企业的工业污染，以及这种影响是否会通过工厂层面的网络传播，进而影响其他地区的污染。首先我们发现，美国国会选举中民主党候选人的微弱获胜，与工厂层面更低的排放和更高的减排相关；当政治人物具有强烈的亲环境偏好时，这种关系尤其明显。我们还发现了重新配置的证据：企业会将排放从民主党代表的地区转移出去。然而，重新配置并不完全：如果企业所在地区由更多民主党人代表，企业层面的成本更高，市值账面比更低。民主党选区工厂周围与污染相关的疾病较少，表明污染影响会传导至当地社区。

articles.title_en: The Cost of Regulatory Compliance in the United States
articles.abstract_en: A key question for studying business dynamism is whether the costs of regulatory compliance fall homogeneously on small and large businesses. Using comprehensive establishment-level occupational microdata and occupation task information, we quantify a firm’s compliance costs as the share of wage bill for performing regulatory compliance tasks (RegIndex). We reveal an inverted-U relationship between firms’ RegIndex and their size: On average, RegIndex for mid-sized firms with around 500 employees is about 47% greater than that of the smallest firms and 18% greater than that of the largest firms. We further develop a shift-share methodology to disentangle the influence of regulatory requirements and enforcement on driving firms’ compliance costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 研究企业活力的一个关键问题是，监管合规成本是否会同等地落在大企业和小企业身上。利用全面的企业层面职业微观数据和职业任务信息，我们将企业合规成本量化为完成监管合规任务的工资总额占比（RegIndex）。我们发现，企业RegIndex与企业规模之间呈倒U形关系：平均而言，拥有约500名员工的中型企业，其RegIndex比最小企业高47%，比最大企业高18%。我们进一步提出一种转移份额方法，以区分监管要求和执法对企业合规成本的影响。

articles.title_en: Heterogeneous Oil Supply Elasticities: Indebtedness and Production Responses to the COVID-19 Shock
articles.title_cn: 异质性的石油供给弹性：负债与COVID-19冲击下的生产反应
articles.abstract_en: Debt matters for oil supply elasticities. We document the resiliency of oil production to the COVID-19-related collapse in demand due to indebtedness. We use exogenous variation in the timing of debt-related payments to identify financially constrained operators. We show that more financially constrained firms cut production by less than less-constrained firms and were less likely to complete new wells. To explore the mechanisms, we use borrowing-limit cuts and credit-line drawdowns to measure access to credit, and we exploit failed hedging practices. The propagation of oil demand shocks crucially depends on the indebtedness of the oil sector.
articles.abstract_cn: 债务会影响石油供给弹性。我们记录了由于负债，石油生产对COVID-19相关需求崩溃表现出的韧性。我们利用债务相关付款时间的外生变化，识别受到财务约束的经营者。我们表明，财务约束更强的企业比约束较弱的企业少削减产量，也较不可能完成新油井。为探究作用机制，我们利用借款限额削减和信用额度支取来衡量信贷可得性，并利用对冲失败的做法。石油需求冲击的传导在关键程度上取决于石油部门的负债状况。
